newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ENDEMOL IN TELEVISION DISTRIBUTION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: ENDEMOL IN TELEVISION DISTRIBUTION DEAL.

text.p: Dutch television and theatre production Endemol Entertainment said on Monday it had closed a deal with U.S. television films maker World International Network (WIN).

Endemol will have the exclusive rights to distribute WIN's English language television films in the Benelux, French speaking Europe, Italy, Scandinavia, Portugal, Turkey, Greece, Cyprus, Israel, Eastern Europe including Russia and Africa.
The four year contract will be extended each year by about 20 new titles in various genres, Endemol said. No financial details of the deal were disclosed.
